cues.zh: 在德国历史上最黑暗的岁月里，煽动的暴民砸碎
cues.en: In the darkest chapter of German history, during a time when incited mobs threw stones

cues.zh: 无辜店主的窗户，妇女和儿童在光天化日之下
cues.en: into the windows of innocent shop owners and women and children were cruelly humiliated

cues.zh: 饱受羞辱；年轻的牧师 Dietrich Bonhoeffer，开始公开站出来反对这些
cues.en: in the open; Dietrich Bonhoeffer, a young pastor, began to speak publicly against the

cues.zh: 暴行。
cues.en: atrocities.

cues.zh: 在多年试图改变人们思想之后的一天傍晚，Bonhoeffer 回到家，
cues.en: After years of trying to change people's minds, Bonhoeffer came home one evening and his own

cues.zh: 他的父亲不得不告诉他，有两个男人正在他的房间里等着带走他。
cues.en: father had to tell him that two men were waiting in his room to take him away.

cues.zh: 在狱中，Bonhoeffer 开始反思，自己那个曾是诗人与思想家的国度，
cues.en: In prison, Bonhoeffer began to reflect on how his country of poets and thinkers had

cues.zh: 为何会变成一群懦夫、骗子和罪犯的集合体。
cues.en: turned into a collective of cowards, crooks and criminals.

cues.zh: 最终他得出结论：问题的根源不在于恶意，而在于愚蠢。
cues.en: Eventually he concluded that the root of the problem was not malice, but stupidity.

cues.zh: 在他著名的狱中书简中，Bonhoeffer 提出，愚蠢是比恶意
cues.en: In his famous letters from prison, Bonhoeffer argued that stupidity is a more dangerous

cues.zh: 对善良更危险的敌人，因为“人们可以反抗邪恶，邪恶可以
cues.en: enemy of the good than malice, because while “one may protest against evil; it can be

cues.zh: 被揭露，也能用武力去制止，但面对愚蠢，我们却毫无防备。
cues.en: exposed and prevented by the use of force, against stupidity we are defenseless.

cues.zh: 抗议和武力在这里都无济于事。
cues.en: Neither protests nor the use of force accomplish anything here.

cues.zh: 讲道理根本没人听。”
cues.en: Reasons fall on deaf ears.”

cues.zh: 违背蠢人成见的事实，他们根本不屑一顾，
cues.en: Facts that contradict a stupid person’s prejudgment simply need not be believed and

cues.zh: 即便铁证如山，也会被轻描淡写地当成无关紧要的个例。
cues.en: when they are irrefutable, they are just pushed aside as inconsequential, as incidental.

cues.zh: 蠢人在此过程中总是自我感觉良好，又极易被激怒，
cues.en: In all this the stupid person, is self-satisfied and, being easily irritated, becomes dangerous

cues.zh: 进而通过主动攻击变得极具危险性。
cues.en: by going on the attack.

cues.zh: 因此，对付蠢人需要比对付恶人
cues.en: For that reason, greater caution is called for when dealing with a stupid person than

cues.zh: 更加小心谨慎。
cues.en: with a malicious one.

cues.zh: 如果我们想知道如何战胜愚蠢，就必须先去了解它的
cues.en: If we want to know how to get the better of stupidity, we must seek to understand its

cues.zh: 本质。
cues.en: nature.

cues.zh: 有一点可以肯定，愚蠢在本质上不是智力缺陷，而是道德缺陷。
cues.en: This much is certain, stupidity is in essence not an intellectual defect but a moral one.

cues.zh: 有些人思维敏捷却极度愚蠢，而另一些人
cues.en: There are human beings who are remarkably agile intellectually yet stupid, and others

cues.zh: 智力平平却绝非蠢人。
cues.en: who are intellectually dull yet anything but stupid.

cues.zh: 给人的印象与其说是愚蠢乃先天缺陷，
cues.en: The impression one gains is not so much that stupidity is a congenital defect but that,

cues.zh: 不如说在某些特定环境下，人变蠢了，或者更确切地说，是他们听任
cues.en: under certain circumstances, people are made stupid or rather, they allow this to happen

cues.zh: 这种情况发生在自己身上。
cues.en: to them.

cues.zh: 独居的人表现出这种缺陷的频率，要低于身处
cues.en: People who live in solitude manifest this defect less frequently than individuals in

cues.zh: 群体中的个人。
cues.en: groups.

cues.zh: 因此，愚蠢与其说是个心理学问题，倒不如说是个社会学问题。
cues.en: And so it would seem that stupidity is perhaps less a psychological than a sociological problem.

cues.zh: 显而易见的是，每当权力急剧膨胀，无论是政治性的还是宗教性的，
cues.en: It becomes apparent that every strong upsurge of power, be it of a political or religious

cues.zh: 都会让很大一部分人染上愚蠢。
cues.en: nature, infects a large part of humankind with stupidity.

cues.zh: 这几乎成了一条社会心理学定律：一方的权力，需要另一方的愚蠢
cues.en: Almost as if this is a sociological-psychological law where the power of the one needs the stupidity

cues.zh: 来支撑。
cues.en: of the other.

cues.zh: 在这里起作用的过程，并不是说人类的某些特定能力（比如智力）突然
cues.en: The process at work here is not that particular human capacities, such as intellect, suddenly

cues.zh: 丧失了。
cues.en: fail.

cues.zh: 相反，在强大权力的压倒性冲击下，人类似乎被剥夺了
cues.en: Instead, it seems that under the overwhelming impact of rising power, humans are deprived

cues.zh: 内心的独立性，并在或多或少有意识的情况下，放弃了自主的立场。
cues.en: of their inner independence and, more or less consciously, give up an autonomous position.

cues.zh: 愚蠢的人往往很顽固，但这绝不能掩盖一个事实：
cues.en: The fact that the stupid person is often stubborn must not blind us from the fact that he is

cues.zh: 他并不独立。
cues.en: not independent.

cues.zh: 与他交谈时，你甚至会觉得根本不是在和他这个人打交道，
cues.en: In conversation with him, one virtually feels that one is dealing not at all with him as

cues.zh: 而是在面对那些占据了他心智的口号、标语之类的东西。
cues.en: a person, but with slogans, catchwords, and the like that have taken possession of him.

cues.zh: 他仿佛中了魔咒，双眼被蒙蔽，被利用，连本性都遭到了践踏。
cues.en: He is under a spell, blinded, misused, and is abused in his very being.

cues.zh: 沦为盲目的工具后，愚蠢的人也将能够做出任何恶行——
cues.en: Having thus become a mindless tool, the stupid person will also be capable of any evil - incapable

cues.zh: 并且无法意识到那是邪恶的。
cues.en: of seeing that it is evil.

cues.zh: 唯有解放的行动，而非说教，才能战胜愚蠢。
cues.en: Only an act of liberation, not instruction, can overcome stupidity.

cues.zh: 这里我们必须接受一个事实：在大多数情况下，真正的内在解放
cues.en: Here we must come to terms with the fact that in most cases a genuine internal liberation

cues.zh: 只有在外部解放先行之后，才成为可能。
cues.en: becomes possible only when external liberation has preceded it.

cues.zh: 在那之前，我们必须放弃所有说服愚蠢之人的尝试。
cues.en: Until then, we must abandon all attempts to convince the stupid person.

cues.en: States liberated the camp.

cues.en: “Action springs not from thought, but from a readiness for responsibility.

cues.en: The ultimate test of a moral society is the kind of world that it leaves to its children.”
